description: Build a dependency graph of the codebase using static analysis (ast-grep). Maps import/require/export relationships between files. Runs in the background — call codebase_graph_status to poll progress until complete.

extraExtensions.description: Comma-separated list of additional file extensions to include in the graph (e.g. '.tpl,.blade'). Files with non-standard extensions are included as leaf nodes (dependency targets). Can also be set globally via EXTRA_EXTENSIONS env var.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory.

name: codebase_graph_build
